evaluator.name: TR-4 validator plus primary-agent synthesis review

contractChecks.evidence: M-01 through M-07 cover RQ-01 through RQ-08 with 111 source references and 76 unique evidence IDs.
Fifteen candidate patterns cover recognition, portfolio, proof, density, motion, portability, and provenance.
Eighteen anti-patterns record failures, signals, exceptions, repair strategies, risks, and tests.
Eight unique dimensions include channel modulation, product modulation, evidence, tensions, tests, and H2 approval gates.
Every mechanism, pattern, and taste dimension remains explicitly unapproved.
The material remains grounded in a deliberately narrow five-brand software panel.

qualityDimensions.evidence: The Markdown matrix and atlases allow review without reading every source dossier.
Structured JSON exposes stable IDs, fields, evidence, risks, modulation, and gates.
All matrix and taste references resolve to known mechanisms or source evidence IDs.
Exact expressions to avoid and promotion gates are explicit throughout.
No research hypothesis is promoted into brand truth or production values.
The approved source set favours direct software relevance over broad cultural range.

notes: TR-4 is complete. TR-5 should minimise Olli's burden through controlled pairs and terse preference responses.
